# foreman_operatingsystem (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_operatingsystem" "centos7" {
  name = "CentOS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the operatingsystem to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `family` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `major` (String)
- `minor` (String)
- `os_parameters_attributes` (Map of String) Array of parameters
- `password_hash` (String, Sensitive) Root password hash function to use
- `release_name` (String)
